nodes.author: Blaze_Trading__
nodes.text:
Health experts confirmed that HMPV is not a new virus—it was first identified in 2001 and has been circulating globally for years.

Symptoms: cough, fever, sore throat, congestion, and sneezing.

✔️ Wash hands frequently
✔️ Wear masks in crowded areas
✔️ Seek medical help for severe symptoms
